column1: npm|core|npm|--version||||||npm ships with Node.js; reinstall Node.js if npm is missing.|
figcraft|core|figcraft|--version||||||No unattended installer in this repo. Install the FigCraft application package for your OS, then rerun preflight. Required for Phase 2 only.|
figcraft-cli|core|figcraft-cli|--version||||||Installed together with the FigCraft application. Add it to PATH, then rerun preflight.|
docker|stack:B|docker|--version||||||Install Docker Desktop (Windows/macOS) or Docker Engine (Linux) manually, then rerun preflight.|
flutter|stack:K|flutter|--version||||||Install the Flutter SDK manually (https://docs.flutter.dev/get-started/install), then run: flutter config --enable-web|
python-markdown|optional|__python_markdown__||python3-markdown|python3-markdown|python-markdown|||Needed only to rebuild GUIDE.html: python3 -m pip install --user markdown|
